paite: Huan hichi ahi ding a, TOUPA na Pathian un gouluah dia gam hon piak a na va lut ua, na va ten chiang un;
heading: Pawltak Thillatte
english: It shall be, when you have come in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you for an inheritance, possess it, and dwell in it,

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un ahon piak na gam leigah tung masapen chiat uh na hon tawi ding ua; bawm ah na koih ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian un amin omsakna dia aseh ding ah na hoh ding uhi.
english: that you shall take some of the first of all the fruit of the ground, which you shall bring in from your land that Yahweh your God gives you. You shall put it in a basket, and shall go to the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to cause his name to dwell there.

paite: Huchi in siampu kiang ah na hoh ding ua, akiang ah, hon piak dia i pi-le-pute kiang a, achiamna gam ka hong tungta uh, chih tuni in TOUPA na Pathian uh kiang ah i hihlang uhi, na chi ding uh.
english: You shall come to the priest who shall be in those days, and tell him, “I profess today to Yahweh your God, that I have come to the land which Yahweh swore to our fathers to give us.”

paite: Siampu in na khut ua kipan bawm ala dia, TOUPA na Pathian uh maitam bul ah anga ding hi.
english: The priest shall take the basket out of your hand, and set it down before Yahweh your God’s altar.

paite: Nou TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, "Ka pu uh Siria mi, mivakvai ahi a, Aigupta gam ah apaisuk a, ava teng a, tawmchik ahi ua; huai ah nam thupitak, thilhihtheitak, tamtak ahong hita uhi.
english: You shall answer and say before Yahweh your God, “My father was a Syrian ready to perish. He went down into Egypt, and lived there, few in number. There he became a great, mighty, and populous nation.

paite: Aigupta mite'n hon simmoh ua, hon hihgenthei ua, nasep haksa pipi hon semsak uh.
english: The Egyptians mistreated us, afflicted us, and imposed hard labor on us.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA i pi-le-pute Pathian i sam ua, TOUPA'N i aw uh ana za a, i gentheihdan, i gimdan leh nuaisiah a i omdan amu hi.
english: Then we cried to Yahweh, the God of our fathers. Yahweh heard our voice, and saw our affliction, our toil, and our oppression.

paite: TOUPA'N Aigupta gam a pan khut hattak, ban zak, thil lauhuaitak, chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte in ahon pikhia a;
english: Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;

paite: hiai mun ah hon pilut a, hiai gam, nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam ahon pia hi.
english: and he has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land flowing with milk and honey.

paite: Ngai in, TOUPA aw, nang na hon piak leigah masapen chiatte ka hon tawi uhi,” na va chi ding uhi. TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah na vual ding ua, TOUPA na Pathian uh bia in na kun ding uhi.
english: Now, behold, I have brought the first of the fruit of the ground, which you, Yahweh, have given me.” You shall set it down before Yahweh your God, and worship before Yahweh your God.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian un na inkuante, noute, Levi mite, na lak ua gamdang mite thil hoih ahon piak tengteng ah kipaktak in na om ding uhi.
english: You shall rejoice in all the good which Yahweh your God has given to you, and to your house, you, and the Levite, and the foreigner who is among you.

paite: Kum thum kum, sawm-a-khat piak kum a na thil tung tengteng uh sawm-a-khat na piak khit uleh, Levi mite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute, meithaite'n na omna uah ane ding uh, ahong khosak theih samna ding un.
english: When you have finished tithing all the tithe of your increase in the third year, which is the year of tithing, then you shall give it to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, that they may eat within your gates and be filled.

paite: TOUPA na Pathian uh ma ah, thu na hon piak tengteng bang in ka inn ua kipan thil siangthoute ka sepkhia ua, Levi mite, gamdang mite, pa neiloute leh meithaite ka peta uh. Na thupiak akoi mahmah ka bohse kei ua, ka mangngilh kei uhi.
english: You shall say before Yahweh your God, “I have put away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, to the foreigner, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all your commandment which you have commanded me. I have not transgressed any of your commandments, neither have I forgotten them.

paite: Ka dah lai un huai ka ne kei ua, ka sian louh lai un ka thehthang sam kei ua, misi tuam a ding in leng ka pe sam kei uhi. TOUPA ka Pathian uh aw ka dawp ua, na hon thupiak tengteng bang in ka hih uhi.
english: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I removed any of it while I was unclean, nor given of it for the dead. I have listened to Yahweh my God’s voice. I have done according to all that you have commanded me.

paite: Na omna siangthou van a pan hon en inla, nawitui leh khuaizu luanna gam, ka pi uh leh pute piak dia na kichiamsa bang in na mi Israelte leh na gam hon piak vualzawl in, na chi ding uh.
english: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”

paite: "Tuni in TOUPA na Pathian un hiai dan leh vaihawmte zui ding in thu ahon pia hi. Huaiziak in na lungtang tengteng uh leh na lungsim tengteng ua pom in na zui ding uh ahi.
heading: Pathian Mite
english: Today Yahweh your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

paite: Tuni in TOUPA lampite zui a, adante, athupiakte leh avaihawmte zui a, a-aw dawp tum in na Pathian ding un na telta uh.
english: You have declared today that Yahweh is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.

paite: Thu ahon chiamsa bang in leh athupiak tengteng na zuihna ding un TOUPA'N tuni in amah a tuambik hi ding in noute ahon na telta hi.
english: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.

paite: Ana gensa bang a TOUPA na Pathian uh a dia a misiangthou na hihtheihna ding un leh nam a bawl tengteng tung a phat, minhoih leh pahtawi a na omtheihna ding un,” achi hi.
english: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to Yahweh your God, as he has spoken.
